heading: Thicc. Glowing. Authentic.
intro: We build every print to actually feel like something, not just look like something on a screen.

items.title: Real thickness
items.body: We use a special medium that builds a genuine, dimensional thickness you can see and feel, just like oil painting.

items.title: Oil-based ink
items.body: We print with oil ink instead of standard pigment. That's what gives it the painterly finish.

items.title: Loose Belgian linen
items.body: Every piece prints on loose Belgian linen. Frame and hang it as-is or stretch it yourself. Your call.
